# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:** Three fundamental divine truths, which exist from et ernity, were ordained by the Divine itself . They were established in the external degrees of the human mind — in the natural plane where regener ation must take its hold .

**¶3:** The first fundamental truth is the sust aining power of divine wisdom in human form — the Divine Human fully ordered — which was called forth by the medi ating infl ux between the celestial kingdom and the lower mind . It was established in a particular degree of consciousness; its foundation extends from the lowest natural understanding all the way to the in most celestial perception . This truth bears up the entire structure of the regener ating mind and becomes the primary support among all truths that carry the weight of spiritual life. In its imm ovable certain ty it stands confirmed , and bin ds together all interior states with all exterior states into one coherent order.

** ¶4:** The second fundamental truth is a new natural mind formed entirely from divine light , established over the old natural mind that was ruled by falsity and the prop rium. It has broken the bonds of the five sensory planes through which spiritual death held the mind capt ive. It has confirmed divine order, with un sh akable certain ty, over and beyond the domain of inherited falsity . It has subd ued, broken apart , and rendered power less the deep est origin of spiritual death — which is the love of self and its ruling falsities.

**¶5 :** The third fundamental truth is divine perception itself — interior understanding proce eding directly from the Lord as Divine Wisdom.

**¶6:** These are the three fundamental divine truths, and they come forth with the full power of the Divine, into three distinct degrees of the mind. They were ordained and distributed across the celest ial, the spiritual, and the natural planes of these same states of human life . They were confirmed and made permanent according to Divine Providence.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three great rocks, which exist, were appointed by the greatness. They were set in these outer worlds.

So, the first rock is the [Pillar] of Glory, the Perfect Man, which was summoned [by the] glorious Ambassador. He set it in this zone; [and he] brought forth its base (?) from the earth to heaven. It bore up under the [en]tire uni[verse], and became first of all the weight-carriers in [it]s powers. In its firmness it has been set upright, and has made fast every [t]hing above and below.

[The] second great and glorious rock is the new earth of light, which was set upon the earth of Darkness. It has squashed the fastenings of the five storehouses of Death. It has established firmness, with great firmness, over and beyond the earth of Darkness. It has flattened, crushed and fixed the root of Death.

[These] are the three great rocks, they that have come forth in great confidence, in three great and honoured places. They were appointed and distributed in three great places of these [self]same worlds. They were made fast according to the will of the greatness.

So, the first rock is the [Pillar] of Glory, the Perfect Man, which was summoned [by the] glorious Ambassador. He set it in this zone; [ ... he] brought forth its base (?) from the earth to heaven. It bore up under the [en]tire uni[verse], and became first of all the weight-carriers in [it]s powers. In its firmness it has been set upright, and has made fast every [t]hing above and below.
